result.summary: Found 1 major content issue: an unresolved technical placeholder/key is displayed as a section header instead of user-facing text.

issues.description: The section header shows 'home_feed.popular_title', which is an unresolved technical key/placeholder, not user-friendly, localized text for this section.
issues.suggestion: Replace this unresolved key with appropriate, localized user-facing text (like 'Popular near you' or a similar descriptive section title) to match the app's standard content style.
